examples.english: Listening to EWF is not so much an experience but more of an anachronism at this point, but nobody said that our older brothers were clueless when it came to looking for entertainment.
examples.ref: 2015 July 22, “El feliz baile anacrónico”, in El País:
examples.text: Escuchar a EWF no constituye a estas alturas tanto una experiencia como una anacronía, pero nadie dijo que nuestros hermanos mayores fueran gente desnortada a la hora de procurarse divertimentos.
examples.translation: Listening to EWF is not so much an experience but more of an anachronism at this point, but nobody said that our older brothers were clueless when it came to looking for entertainment.
